followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain the non-state vehicle roadblocks at the disputed Kosovo–Serbia boundary, not a universal state border-closure decree. Jarinje and Brnjak vehicle access were obstructed; documented pedestrian passage remains an exception. Retain September 20–October 2, 2021 as a 12-calendar-day scoped operational interval. Actual removal is reported, not merely a deployment plan. The licence-plate dispute supports the recorded interstate-dispute/retaliation rationale, attributed to the reporting. RFE/RL and the Reuters report were read; Reuters republication and its caption are one reporting origin, with no separate image inspection. Both named crossings remain unlocated in the current phase, with null coordinates and no changed territorial claim.
